title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Claude Fable 5.1 Launch & Pricing Debate: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 with a 1M context window and updated Claude Code, setting benchmark records (scoring 66 on Artificial Analysis Index) while triggering developer discussions over high-effort API costs and Max tier rate limits.

OpenAI Internal Codex Culture: Gergely Orosz highlighted that internal OpenAI teams are deeply 'Codex-pilled', utilizing internal iterations far more capable than public releases alongside new direct subscription gift cards.

Leopold Aschenbrenner Portfolio Disclosure: Former OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner's fund holdings were published, showing heavy concentration in memory chipmakers SanDisk ($SNDK) and Micron ($MU) alongside Bloom Energy ($BE) and TSMC ($TSM).

Bessent Outlines Strait of Hormuz Energy Bypass: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced new global transit infrastructure that will enable energy shipping to bypass the Strait of Hormuz within two years.

Robert Kiyosaki Facing $1.2B Debt & Market Signals: Financial news highlighted 'Rich Dad Poor Dad' author Robert Kiyosaki confronting $1.2B in debt, while incoming Apple CEO John Ternus prepares for a $58M pay structure.

items.title: @ClaudeCodeLog: Claude Fable 5.1 Released in Claude Code 2.1.257
items.body: Anthropic updated Claude Code to version 2.1.257, setting Claude Fable 5.1 (1M context window) as the default model at $10/$50 per million tokens and introducing auto-mode prompt optimizations.

items.title: @GergelyOrosz: Inside OpenAI's Deep 'Codex-Pilled' Development Culture
items.body: Tech writer Gergely Orosz noted that OpenAI internal teams heavily rely on advanced, unreleased versions of Codex that far surpass publicly available developer tools.

items.title: @simonw: Simon Willison Tests Claude Fable 5.1 High-Reasoning Capabilities
items.body: Simon Willison tested Claude Fable 5.1 at maximum thinking levels, achieving unprecedented SVG vector generation and animation quality while noting the higher per-task token cost ($3.30 for complex rendering).

items.title: @cheatyyyy: Fable 5.1 Sets Benchmark Records on Artificial Analysis Index
items.body: AI benchmark tracking showed Claude Fable 5.1 scoring a record 66 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, while setting new benchmarks for deep multi-step reasoning.

items.title: @Mileson07: OpenAI Introduces Direct Subscription Gift Cards
items.body: OpenAI launched official gift cards for ChatGPT and Codex subscriptions, enabling international users to activate and renew accounts directly without third-party payment workarounds.

items.title: @Zai_org: Z.ai Celebrates GLM 1-Year Anniversary with Quota Resets
items.body: AI platform Z.ai celebrated the one-year milestone of the GLM Coding Plan by issuing Reset Cards to subscribers, refilling weekly and 5-hour quota allocations.

items.title: @RLanceMartin: Cost-Efficiency Tips for Deploying Fable 5.1
items.body: AI engineer Lance Martin shared optimization guidelines for Fable 5.1, noting that low-effort reasoning settings achieve competitive results with Sonnet while dramatically lowering per-task costs on CursorBench.

items.body: Public disclosures revealed former OpenAI alignment researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner's core fund positions, led by heavy allocations in SanDisk ($SNDK 28.1%), Micron ($MU 27.6%), Bloom Energy ($BE 9.4%), and TSMC ($TSM 6%).
